title: Drydock Player
description: A modpack for players of the boatracing server called The Drydock
body:
# Drydock This is a modpack for the boatracing server called "The Drydock"
## What is this pack for? This modpacks aims to be a lightweight and simple base for boatracing that bundles the essential assets to play on **The Drydock** - If you are playing on the Drydock server, this modpack pre-configures everything you need to **join and race boats** - If you aren't playing on the Drydock server, you can still use this modpack as an optimized boatracing client with custom resources you can use in singleplayer or for developing your own server ## Content Drydock resources: - [Drydock Resourcepack](https://github.com/muggelpotato/drydock-resourcepack) adds custom item/entity models and sounds - Drydock Mod soon™ Boatracing: - [OpenBoatUtils](https://modrinth.com/mod/openboatutils) for configurable boat physics - [BoatHUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/boathud) to monitor boat speed/angle and inputs Visuals: - [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) for extended render distance - [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) & [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) required to use the resourcepack Performance: - Most of the mods and configs from [Fabulously Optimized](https://github.com/Fabulously-Optimized/fabulously-optimized) And the usual QOL mods and configs ## Suggestions If you are a player or builder of the server and want to suggest mods to be added, create a GitHub issue ## Other If you are looking to create your own hobby boatracing server like ours you might want to check out [Wake](https://github.com/muggelpotato/wake)
Pull requests for all of Drydock's assets are welcome ## Credits The Modpack is built upon [Fabulously Optimized](https://github.com/Fabulously-Optimized/fabulously-optimized) The Modpack is using [More Culling](https://github.com/fxmorin/moreculling) by FxMorin
